what: Pressing the menu button spreads a brush-edge mask (200% size, position -100% → 100%) from the bottom-right corner to cover the panel, and the inner text wobbles like heat haze through SVG turbulence displacement (baseFrequency .005·.05 → 0, scale 50 → 0), settling in 1 second. The three burger lines slide out to the right for .3s each at .15s intervals, the two X lines come in the same way after .5s, the MENU letters rise away one by one (.2s, .1s apart), and CLOSE rises in from below after .3s. On close, the X drops down with a .15s stagger, the three lines return after .45s, the cells drop 3vh at .15s intervals, and the panel fades out over .5s.

options.dur: Opening duration (seconds), default 1 — line and letter motion keep the original values
options.back: Length of each X·line step on close (s), default .2
options.from: Minimum window width (px) for applying the heat haze, default 814 — phones get only the mask
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Cover panel — hidden by fx.css when closed
options.[data-fx-part=warp]: Inner wrapper that hangs the heat haze (optional). A box that drops 3vh when the child right below closes
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Three burger lines (an svg line slips outside the svg and gets clipped)
options.[data-fx-part=open-label]·[data-fx-part=: MENU·CLOSE text — the part splits it apart one character at a time

from.where: shared.js header menu (.dd-menu) — original script.js Menu (#modalTurbulence .005,.05→0 · #modalDisplacement 50→0 · --mask -100%→100% · lines .3s stagger .15 · close .2s)

note: On open and close, an fx:menu event (detail.open) is raised from the element — stopping and restarting smooth scroll is done by the consumer listening to it. The original has no separate curve on the open timeline’s default 1s length (the expo.out on the turbulence side is written on the start value and ignored), so everything uses the GSAP default power1.out. The cover art is a drawn brush edge. Esc also closes it. With reduced motion it opens and closes instantly
